# Research streams and software {.display-name style="font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.2rem)"}

::: {.lede style="font-size:1.05rem; margin-top:1.2rem"}
Two kinds of work, kept side by side on purpose: long-running research programmes, and the
tools built so that other people can do the analysis themselves.
:::
:::

::: {.section-split}
::: {.label}
[Research streams]{.eyebrow}

***
:::
::: {.card-grid}

::: {.flat-card}
### Land reform in Kazakhstan

Thirty years of land-allocation reform evaluated across 200 rayon-level units, combining
administrative and geospatial data with the natural experiment of pasture privatization.

::: {.chips}
[Impact evaluation]{.chip} [Google Earth Engine]{.chip}
:::
:::

::: {.flat-card}
### Land valuation in Ukraine

Mass valuation of agricultural and urban land — regression-based methods adopted by the
State Cadaster, and listing-data approaches for urban property where records are thin.

::: {.chips}
[Cadaster]{.chip} [Machine learning]{.chip} [PostGIS]{.chip}
:::
:::

::: {.flat-card}
### GeoPov

A World Bank working programme joining microdata with geospatial data to read spatial
income and welfare disparities.

::: {.chips}
[Poverty mapping]{.chip} [Microdata]{.chip}
:::
:::

:::

::: {.section-split}
::: {.label}
[Software]{.eyebrow}

***
:::
::: {.card-grid}

::: {.flat-card}
### peaApp

R Shiny application for poverty and equity analysis — packaging country workflows into
something a counterpart can run without an analyst in the room.

[R · Shiny]{.chip}
:::

::: {.flat-card}
### devCEQ

R package for scaling up fiscal microsimulation Shiny apps — deployed for Senegal, Côte
d'Ivoire, Benin, Indonesia, Romania, Türkiye, El Salvador, and Armenia.

[worldbank.github.io/devCEQ →](https://worldbank.github.io/devCEQ/){.card-link}
:::

::: {.flat-card}
### devPTIpack

Project Targeting Index tooling: spatial and micro data combined to improve how development
projects choose where to work.

[worldbank.github.io/devPTIpack →](https://worldbank.github.io/devPTIpack){.card-link}
:::

::: {.flat-card}
### lassopmm

Lassoing welfare dynamics — synthetic panel construction with machine learning, packaged
for reuse.

[R]{.chip}
:::

:::
:::
